responsibility: This file implements tree_widget, a widget subclass for rendering hierarchical tree diagrams with themed connector lines. It constructs tree nodes from strings or pretty-printer output using dump_widget_info, computes stacked layout with a fixed child indentation margin, allocates child rectangles, and paints node content plus final/non-final branch connectors onto a canvas according to the active theme and tree style id; it also provides selftests for ASCII and Unicode tree rendering.
same_name_distinction: Implements tree_widget creation helpers, layout, connector painting, and tree-rendering selftests; unlike gcc/text-art/tree-widget.h, it contains the concrete tree diagram behavior rather than the subclass declaration.
